name: Kousuke
source:
A gloomy young man who used to be in the same otaku group as [url=https://vndb.org/c139560]Haruki[/url]. Unable to move on from his feelings for her, he becomes depressed and stays that way forever. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
